atoms.text: Recurring schedules remain canonical; date-specific changes use SKIP/REPLACE overlays.
Planner UI must render exception-expanded schedules, not raw recurrence rows.
Specialist evidence may influence recovery/checkpoints/unit span but never schedule date.
Repeated PARTIAL -> carry escalation -> specialist evidence -> reinterpretation -> finer units -> replanning passes browser runtime.
Birthdate is the only required learner-age input; do not infer grade/region/curriculum.
Capture review/reanalysis and English capture-to-FACT-to-Planner paths pass browser runtime.
Family session had member_id while data scopes were historically shared.
Use central ReadyMemberScope for storage and sync scope.
Conflict list/count must filter active member and parse member-scoped labels.
Concurrent same-branch updates require live refresh and sequential file-SHA updates; never force push.
Exact captured-head Runtime E2E and some CI gates were still running.
Real OCR provider, production sync, device validation and deploy remain external-resource-gated.
